 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Luka Doncic and the Los Angeles Lakers face Darius Garland and the Los Angeles Clippers during the 2026-27 NBA regular season.
 The Clippers enter the matchup following a 108-101 loss to Shai Gilgeous-Alexander and the Oklahoma City Thunder on Sunday. Guard Darius Garland finished with a game-high 11 assists and a team-high 16 points. Garland currently leads Los Angeles in scoring at 24.0 points per game, to go along with a team-high 7.0 assists. Forward Rui Hachimura averages a team-high 6.0 rebounds, while guard Kris Dunn averages 3.3 steals. Center Brook Lopez averages a team-high 1.7 blocks.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Lakers vs Clippers TV Channels and Live Stream Options
 Los Angeles Clippers guard Darius Garland (10).D. Ross Cameron-Imagn Images
 Time: 10:30 p.m. ET
 Venue: Intuit Dome, Inglewood
 TV: NBA League Pass, DirecTV
 Live stream: NBA League Pass through Amazon Prime Video
 Fans can watch for free through DirecTV. Users can subscribe to DirecTV with a free trial that can be canceled before five days.
 The Lakers enter the matchup following their first loss of the 2026-27 NBA regular season, suffering a 136-129 loss to the Portland Trail Blazers on Monday. Doncic scored a game-high 41 points, to go along with five rebounds and nine assists. Guard Austin Reaves scored 26 points on 8-for-13 shooting from the field, along with seven assists and four rebounds. Doncic currently ranks first in the league at 36.0 points per game, while Los Angeles ranks second in the league in scoring at 128.3 points per game.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The Clippers next face the Minnesota Timberwolves on Friday, while the Lakers face Stephen Curry and the Golden State Warriors that same day.
